Subject: Severe inference latency + token errors — need detailed RCA and next steps

Olga,

Thanks for the quick acknowledgement via the console alert last night. We saw a sustained spike in per-request latency and an increase in token-generation errors between 02:14–02:56 UTC on 2028-03-29 which caused a failure rate of ~6% for our production traffic (affecting our payment flow).

Our legal/compliance team is asking for a written RCA, timeline of events, a summary of impact (requests affected, approximate percentage of tokens re-tried), and the concrete remediation steps you will take to prevent recurrence. We also need an ETA for the full incident report for our records — this is required for our auditors.

Can you provide a short summary today and a full RCA by tomorrow EOD? We may request a call if needed.

-Anita

Best,

Summary outline (working):
1) Executive summary — impact window, customer impact, and high-level root cause.
2) Timeline — per-minute annotated timeline from our logs + customer request IDs.

- The driver experienced a 1.1s timeout on ~0.5% of kernels, which caused the runtime to fall back to a slower path, producing token retry errors in 6% of affected requests.

Date: 2028-03-30T16:27:00Z
Subject: Final: RCA, timeline, and remediation tracker — Solvent AI (Mar 29 incident)

Hi Anita / Raj / Support Team,

Thank you again for your patience. Attached is our formal customer-facing RCA packet. Below is a concise summary and the action tracker we will execute with owners and target dates. The full packet and raw evidence are in the Drive link included.

Executive summary:
- Impact window: 02:14–02:56 UTC, 2028-03-29.
- Visible customer effect: increased 95th/99th percentile latency and token-generation errors that caused ~6% failed requests for Solvent AI’s payment orchestration route during the window. Estimated affected requests: ~1,200 (0.8% of daily traffic).
- Root cause: interaction between an autoscaling policy regression and a GPU driver timing edge that caused a fall-back to a slower execution path under specific batch/sequence distributions.
- Data security: no data exfiltration or unauthorized access detected.

Timeline (high level):
- 02:12 UTC — first error report in internal telemetry; brief spike in kernel timeouts.
- 02:14 UTC — customer errors begin surfacing; automated alerts escalated.
- 02:20–02:30 UTC — attempted automated autoscaler correction; a delayed evaluation caused transient under-provisioning for a few minutes.
- 02:34 UTC — mitigation: forced scale-up of dedicated pool and application of temporary driver workarounds.
- 02:56 UTC — metrics returned to baseline; continued close monitoring.

Mitigations already applied:
- Applied driver pin to the affected image and rolled to the impacted nodes (complete 02:40 UTC).
- Forced scale-up override for the customer’s dedicated pool to avoid under-provisioning during the autoscaler rollback window.
- Cleared problematic batching heuristic in the autoscaler config to prevent small-request clustering.

Action items (owner — ETA):
1) Driver regression hardening: pin tested driver and add kernel-timeout regression tests in our CI (Hannah Schmitt — 2028-04-06).
2) Autoscaler safety checks: add rollout gating and additional logging around batching heuristics (Infra team / Hannah — 2028-04-13).
3) Customer route safeguards: enable per-route fallback threshold + early-warning alerts for your payment route (Olga Petrov / Jordan Blake — 2028-04-03).
4) Post-incident verification: joint replay session with Solvent traces to validate mitigations (Jordan Blake — schedule by 2028-04-05).

Attached files: 20280330_solvent_rca.pdf (customer-facing RCA), 20280330_timeline.xlsx (per-minute timeline), 20280330_action_tracker.csv (action items and owners). Full evidence folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aBcdExampleRCADocs

If you prefer a live walkthrough of the packet we'll join — Jordan will reach out to schedule. We appreciate the collaboration and will keep you posted as items are closed.

Best regards,
Olga Petrov
Senior Account Manager, Redwood Inference
